d:
From unexpected stories to hilarious celebrity banter, Josh Gates knows how to keep a conversation entertaining! Join him as he chats with some of Hollywood's biggest names, from Christopher Lloyd and Robert Englund to Kevin Bacon, Gabriel Iglesias and Giancarlo Esposito. These conversations take plenty of amusing turns, and Josh is always ready with the next question!
Watch Josh Gates Tonight, S3, Episodes 2, 1, 6, 5, 4 & 3 on Discovery Channel India.
